description: This file contains unit tests for the HasFieldErrors matcher class, which verifies the presence of specific field errors within Spring's Errors object. It tests various scenarios including matching based on field names and error codes, and verifying descriptive output.

classes.name: HasFieldErrorsTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class that verifies the behavior of the HasFieldErrors matcher, ensuring it correctly identifies the presence or absence of field errors in a Spring Errors object under various conditions.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test objects before each test, including an Alert instance wrapped in a BindException, and a description object.

methods.name: shouldAppendFieldErrorsDescriptionIfFieldAndCodeAreNull
methods.description: Verifies that the description output correctly states 'to have field errors' when no specific field or code is provided.

methods.name: shouldAppendNoErrorForSpecificFieldIfFieldIsNonNull
methods.description: Checks description output when a specific field is specified, expecting 'to have field errors for 'uuid''.

methods.name: shouldAppendNoErrorForSpecificFieldAndCodeIfFieldAndCodeAreNonNull
methods.description: Ensures description correctly states errors exist for a specific field and code.

methods.name: shouldNotMatchIfFieldAndCodeAreNullAndGivenErrorHasNoFieldErrors
methods.description: Asserts that matcher does not match when no errors exist and no specific field or code is specified.

methods.name: shouldMatchIfFieldAndCodeAreNullAndGivenErrorHasFieldErrors
methods.description: Checks that the matcher correctly matches when errors with field errors are present and no specific field or code is specified.

methods.name: shouldNotMatchIfFieldIsNonNullAndGivenErrorDoesNotHaveFieldErrors
methods.description: Verifies that the matcher does not match when a specific field is expected but no errors are present for it.

methods.name: shouldNotMatchIfFieldIsNonNullButNotContainedInGivenErrors
methods.description: Tests that no match occurs if specific field is set and errors are only on other fields.

methods.name: shouldMatchIfFieldIsNonNullAndContainedInGivenErrors
methods.description: Checks that the matcher correctly matches when errors are present on the specified field.

methods.name: shouldNotMatchIfFieldAndCodeAreNonNullAndGivenErrorDoesNotHaveFieldErrors
methods.description: Ensures no match occurs when specific field and code are given but errors do not contain them.

methods.name: shouldNotMatchIfFieldAndCodeAreNonNullAndGivenErrorsDoesNotContainSpecificErrorCode
methods.description: Verifies no match if the errors on a field do not include the specified error code.

methods.name: shouldNotMatchIfFieldAndCodeAreNonNullAndGivenErrorsDoesNotContainSpecificField
methods.description: Checks for no match when errors exist on other fields but not the specified field.

methods.name: shouldMatchIfFieldAndCodeAreNonNullAndContainedInGivenErrorsWithASingleFieldError
methods.description: Verifies match when a specific error code is present on the specified field.

methods.name: shouldMatchIfFieldAndCodeAreNonNullAndContainedInGivenErrorsWithMultipleFieldErrors
methods.description: Checks that multiple errors on the specified field with the correct code result in a match.
